description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Black-gram
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies tax rates on specific commodities (Black gram), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera by name, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - the ministerial reference is only to establish the authority making the regulatory decision. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
